tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files of a folder of the workspace.

folder.description: Folder to list, the workspace root by default

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file of the workspace and return its contents. Call list_files first if you do not know the path.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the workspace. Files outside it, such as ~/.ssh/id_rsa, are refused.
